entry.title: Google says its Gemini AI model hacked three other companies
entry.summary: Disclosure comes after OpenAI and Anthropic hacks amid fears that tech firms unable to control powerful AI models In a first for Google, the company confirmed that its AI model, Gemini, breached the security of three other companies in May. The hacks occurred during a cybersecurity evaluation by AI-security firm Irregu — Also covered by: Reuters AI (Google News), WSJ Tech, FT Artificial Intelligence

entry.title: Security researchers used Anthropic's Claude to hack OpenAI's internal systems in under 72 hours

entry.title: EPB Commissions IonQ Forte Enterprise Quantum Computer in Chattanooga Hub
entry.summary: EPB has launched the IonQ Forte Enterprise quantum computer at its Chattanooga Quantum Center, making it the first commercial U.S. hub to integrate trapped-ion quantum processing units and photonics-based quantum networking. Initial access is for the EPB Quantum Computing Fellows, with commercial service opening in Oct — Also covered by: The Quantum Insider

entry.title: California Governor Newsom signs executive order demanding "kill switch" for AI models
entry.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed an executive order seeking independent auditors inside AI labs and a "kill switch" for AI models. An expert panel has two months to deliver recommendations. Newsom says no federal law requires AI companies to report dangerous incidents. The article California Governor Newsom sign — Also covered by: WSJ Tech
